name: Forms
description: Make forms and collect answers, like Google Forms, on your own server. Build one in the editor, share its link, and read the responses as a summary, a table or a CSV. Anyone with the link can answer; everything else stays behind your nook login.

env.desc: Who gets an email for each response (needs the email service, like Mail relay)
The address those emails come from, on a domain the email service sends for
